fast_input_loop.limits: Includes straight idealized IC internal VIN-to-GND and capacitor internal bridges solely to close a geometric polygon. Not loop inductance, actual package/current distribution, EMI or transient simulation.

bulk_input_bypass.limitation: The 100 nF C41 fast loop does not substitute for the required effective input bank. C42/C40 and their longer current loop need extracted/transient review; neither this length nor nominal capacitance establishes stable operation.

source_contract.input_rating: 3–17 V recommended, 18 V abs. max; not raw USB
source_contract.configuration: 26.1k MODE: 2.5MHz auto PFM/PWM, AEE, discharge; FB/VSET open selects 3.3V
source_contract.PG_terminal: R46 pin2 / IC pin1; pull-up complete, downstream consumer not claimed

thermal_and_current_limits: Resistance uses bulk copper resistivity at20C and uniform18/35um thickness; excludes etch, plating, pads, via, skin/proximity and temperature rise. It is not a current rating.

At1A output the buck input pin carries pulsed inductor current, not simply DC input average. Prior component model gives2.03125A planning peak with minimum-inductance assumptions, not a guaranteed measured bound.

IC GND has only a0.15mm terminal neck, one nearby ordinary via and explicit B.Cu return in this trial. No actual GND plane/fill or validated package spreading exists. TI calls for wide thick metal and VIN/GND thermal vias; full plane/thermal design remains unfinished.
The 0.5/0.25mm EN via is an ordinary signal via;13 others are0.6/0.3mm. Drill-to-land minimum is checked across allSMDlands including same-net.
